# MicroCAD — LLM Context

> MicroCAD is a lightweight browser-based 2D CAD application.
> Live app: https://agustin-del-pino.github.io/microcad/
> Documentation: https://agustin-del-pino.github.io/microcad/docs/

## What you can do with this documentation

Read https://agustin-del-pino.github.io/microcad/docs/ to understand the .mcad file format
and generate valid CAD drawings by producing a JSON file the user can open in MicroCAD.

## .mcad file format (summary)

A .mcad file is JSON with the following root structure:

```json
{
  "version": 4,
  "GRID": 20,
  "unitScale": 1,
  "cfg": {
    "projectName": "string",
    "baseUnit": "mm|cm|m|km",
    "displayUnit": "mm|cm|m|km",
    "bgColor": "#hex",
    "gridColor": "#hex",
    "exportBgColor": "#hex",
    "exportGridColor": "#hex"
  },
  "layers": [
    { "id": 1, "name": "string", "opacity": 1, "visible": true }
  ],
  "shapes": [ /* see shape types below */ ]
}
```

## Coordinate system

- Origin (0,0) at canvas center
- X grows right, Y grows down
- 1 canvas unit = unitScale × baseUnit (e.g. unitScale=1, baseUnit="mm" → 1u = 1mm)
- GRID = snap grid spacing (default 20). Use multiples of GRID for aligned shapes.

## Shape types

Every shape requires a "layerId" matching an existing layer id.

### line
{"type":"line","x1":0,"y1":0,"x2":100,"y2":0,"layerId":1}

### rect  (x,y = top-left corner)
{"type":"rect","x":-50,"y":-25,"w":100,"h":50,"layerId":1}

### circle
{"type":"circle","cx":0,"cy":0,"r":50,"layerId":1}

### triangle
{"type":"triangle","p1":{"x":0,"y":-50},"p2":{"x":50,"y":50},"p3":{"x":-50,"y":50},"layerId":1}

### arc  (angles in radians; ccw=true for counter-clockwise)
{"type":"arc","cx":0,"cy":0,"r":50,"sa":0,"ea":3.14159,"ccw":false,"layerId":1}
Angle reference: 0=right, π/2=down, π=left, 3π/2=up

### poly  (polyline or polygon)
{"type":"poly","pts":[{"x":0,"y":0},{"x":100,"y":0},{"x":50,"y":80}],"closed":true,"layerId":1}

### ruler  (same as line but renders the measured distance as a label)
{"type":"ruler","x1":0,"y1":100,"x2":200,"y2":100,"layerId":1}

### ground  (support/ground line symbol used in engineering)
{"type":"ground","x1":-100,"y1":50,"x2":100,"y2":50,"layerId":1}

### angledim  (angle dimension: vertex + two arm endpoints)
{"type":"angledim","vx":0,"vy":0,"p1x":100,"p1y":0,"p2x":0,"p2y":-100,"layerId":1}

### group  (nested shapes)
{"type":"group","children":[/* shapes */],"layerId":1}

## Instructions for generating a .mcad file

1. Center drawings around the origin (0,0) when possible.
2. Always include "layerId" in every shape, matching a layer defined in "layers".
3. Use multiples of GRID for dimensions and positions (default GRID=20).
4. Output the complete JSON inside a ```json ... ``` code block.
5. Valid JSON only — no comments inside the final JSON.
6. The user will save your output as a .mcad file and open it with MicroCAD → Open.
